name: bench-002-pi4-case-v1
summary: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B open-top case: floored tray, 4 M2.5 standoffs on a 58x49 rectangle, perimeter walls, port cutouts, ventilation, 2mm walls, PLA, no supports.
status: FOUNDATION BUILT — the pi4_mount + pi4_ports validator checkers exist and a hand-authored open-tray reference (tests/fixtures/handwritten/pi4_case_good.partdsl.json) compiles and passes all required_checks. Still pending: the LLM-facing Pi4CaseInterpreter (ADR-0005).

dimensions.spec: 4x M2.5 holes on a 58x49 rectangle, 3.5mm inset from board edges
M2.5 clearance hole in each standoff
board sits above the floor to clear underside solder
gap between board edge and inner wall
from vertical, printable floor-down without support

required_interfaces.must_present: 4x M2.5 clearance holes on a 58x49 rectangle, concentric in standoffs
wall cutouts clearing the USB/Ethernet long edge and the USB-C/micro-HDMI short edge

hard_constraints: mesh manifold, watertight, single shell (the tray)
printable floor-down on FDM without supports (overhangs <= 45 deg)
board fits the cavity with >= board_clearance on every side
standoff screw holes keep a >= min_wall land to the standoff outer edge
